stories.headline: Tree-planting interest runs ahead of confidence with a shovel
stories.body: The Arbor Day Foundation’s 2026 Canopy Report finds that 58% of U.S. adults say they lack the knowledge to plant a tree alone. Eight in ten say they would plant one tomorrow if someone provided a tree and showed them how; four in five report…

featuredResource.title: The Forester’s Fieldbook
featuredResource.description: The Forester’s Fieldbook is a mobile-oriented reference app for classic forestry tables and calculations. It brings tree scale, log scale, prism cruising and stocking-guide references together for field use.
